subject.title: [BUG]: Browser tool: `snapshot` returns page content before scroll, ignoring viewport position

question: Should browser snapshot gain an additive viewport-aware read mode or should the existing snapshot action change its default semantics to the visible viewport?
rationale: The source confirms the gap, but the fix changes model-facing browser semantics and compatibility with current full-tree snapshot workflows.

options.title: Add viewport-aware mode
options.body: Add an explicit visible-viewport snapshot or viewport metadata mode while keeping full AI/ARIA snapshots available for existing workflows.

options.title: Change snapshot default
options.body: Make snapshot text follow the current visible viewport by default, accepting the compatibility risk for workflows that expect full-page trees.

options.title: Keep current contract
options.body: Document that snapshot is a structured page tree and direct visual-position workflows to screenshots with labels and annotations.

recommendation.title: Add viewport-aware mode
recommendation.body: Add an explicit visible-viewport snapshot or viewport metadata mode while keeping full AI/ARIA snapshots available for existing workflows.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about the browser plugin's public contract and docs, and this history points to steipete as the strongest product-boundary owner.
